Class DataBank

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.DataBank
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DataBank extends Object implements Serializable
The DataBank class acts as the personal ledger and inventory for a specific player. It tracks character card counts, scientific inventions, various point accumulators, and persistent discounts used during the game. It also handles specific event tracking (like completing character sets or gathering identical pairs of inventions).

  • Method Details

    • getCharacterCount

      public int getCharacterCount(CharacterType type)
      Retrieves the count of a specific character type, or calculates virtual types like complete sets and paired inventions.

      WARNING: Querying SamePairInventions causes a side-effect that consumes the pair (sets sameInvention to false).

      Parameters:
      type - the CharacterType to query.
      Returns:
      the amount of cards of that type, the number of complete sets, or 1 if a pair is consumed.
